title: Rc Npm Install
objective: Validate clean native npm installation, relocation, upgrade, uninstall, and operation without a source checkout or build toolchain.

handoff.summary: Replaced the shallow package smoke test with an eight-stage, registry-disconnected Linux x64 release proof. It installs the root archive without optional natives, verifies an actionable missing-platform diagnostic and compiler-free portable operation, adds the explicit platform archive, exercises the native SEA CLI and sagepython with exact ZZ/QQ mathematics, diagnoses the current programmatic native-API limitation, relocates the complete installation, checks explicit source override and corrupt-executable behavior, reinstalls after deleting all package-manager state, removes and reinstalls both public packages, and rejects a byte-corrupted archive. Published launchers now fail closed instead of accidentally entering an unusable source checkout when a supported native package is absent. Release metadata, helper behavior, and diagnostics have focused tests.
risks: The current platform package is a self-contained CLI SEA, not a relocatable programmatic Node-addon distribution. The release test records that distinction explicitly: native CLI mathematics passes while the native JavaScript API produces an actionable diagnostic; portable programmatic operation remains available with SAGEJS_NATIVE_DISABLE=1.
The full archive lifecycle was executed on Linux x64. The validator is platform-parametric, but macOS arm64, Linux arm64, and Windows x64 require their release archives and CI hosts.

Portable validation is intentionally recorded as 270/271 here. Its only failure is the shared test-manifest ratchet because this lane does not own test/node-test-manifest.cjs; integration will register the two new tests and rerun it.
next_steps: Cherry-pick this commit into integration, register test/release-npm-install.cjs and test/npm-native-api-diagnostic.cjs in test/node-test-manifest.cjs, rerun pnpm test:portable, and then mark the integrated task review.
Run scripts/test-npm-package.cjs against every platform archive in release CI, always with its root archive from the same release candidate.
After this RC, either publish relocatable native Node-addon assets for the programmatic API or formally define the platform packages as CLI-only.
